g.title: work_loop
g.text: The work loop: every step leaves a trace

g.title: present
g.text: show the escalation in its own words; stop

g.title: actions
g.text: .cairn/in-progress names the action, or PATH is clean at HEAD
the in-progress record is gone; the action finished or abandoned
the named record reads, and nothing else changed
receipt(REQ).commit = HEAD and current(m, REQ); the receipt is committed
as run, result = pass, and the receipt carries a tried line (the violating example and what the check printed)
an adversary's record for the mechanism exists at HEAD; the review answers each attempt
an adversary's record for the change exists at HEAD; the review answers each attempt
reviewed(m) carries REQ H(text(REQ)), committed; no code changed
three attempts without a pass: an escalation names REQ
review.commit = report.commit = HEAD, both committed, every report finding carried by number
no finding is open; each resolution its own commit
the path is declared, or a retention or restoration is approved
the item carries its reason it is outside, or an escalation names it
Fixed by names a commit that changes no Agreed text, and REQ passes at or after it
Realized by names a commit that resolves
promotion decision; requirement Agreed by it; commitment; roadmap Current:; item stamped
no unpushed commit carries an attribution line

g.title: claim
g.text: each naming an observation or 'not checked'

g.title: adversary
g.text: At the three points: start an adversary
with none of the context; give it the claims;
